newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends down on importers' dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends down on importers' dlr demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished lower on Wednesday at 42.3800/42.3950 to the dollar in interbank trading compared with the previous close at 42.3725/42.3925, dealers said.

Dealers said the taka eased further on higher demand for dollars from importers after opening at 42.3750/42.3950. "There was moderate demand for dollars in the market. The trade volume was around $30 million," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
Interbank call money rates closed flat at 4.0 percent to 4.5 percent, they said.
